evidence.planOrModel: Oral: Claude $20 plan. Screenshot 1 is ccusage (local Claude/Codex logs at API rates), not an official quota console. Screenshot 2 is a chat explaining the ccusage tool.

evidence.oralText: 我的天呐Claude大人，29亿Tokens！还有3天会员到期，而我已经消耗了29亿tokens，折合美元1000多美元，折合人民币6600元。昨天刷新额度，我还剩下100%的周额度没有使用，上一周，周额度用了60%多，使用了一次完全重置。由此可以推断。 Claude 20刀套餐提供的额度换算成tokens要在40亿以上！
evidence.quotaPercent: Oral only: after yesterday's refresh, 100% weekly remaining; previous week 60%+ used plus one full reset. No official % in either image.

tokens.source: third-party ccusage local logs at API rates, Oct+Nov combined, Claude+Codex
tokens.note: Mostly cache-read. API-dollar estimate ≠ subscription allowance.

evidence.conflictsToKeep: 29亿 is the two-month Claude+Codex log total (~2.95B), not a single weekly official quota. Oral 100% weekly remaining after refresh is not in the screenshots. The inferred '40亿以上 for a $20 plan' is forbidden pool extrapolation and must not be adopted. Currency is USD in the table; oral also gives RMB 6600.
evidence.recommendation: 暂不采用任何上线数字，尤其禁止 40 亿推断
evidence.why: 第三方本地日志跨两个月、含 Codex、以缓存读取为主，且无官方配额%；口述 40 亿是反推，禁止采用。
